title: WPSS/1091/2004 of MAHABIR PRASAD GAIROLA Vs UTTARNACHAL POWER CORP. and ORS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1091 of 2004
Hon'ble Kalyan Jyoti Sengupta, J.
 Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate present for the
petitioner.
 Mr. B.D. Upadhyaya, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Sunil Upadhyaya, Advocate present
for the respondents.
 After hearing the learned counsel for the
parties, and going through the pleadings and
noting the judgmement of Supreme Court in Civil
Appeal No.3448 of 2008 Rakesh Sharma & Ors.
Vs. Chairman/Managing Director, Uttaranchal
Power Corporation & Ors. alongwith connected
matters, I feel that no decision is required to be
rendered by this Court. The issues are squarely
covered by the decision of Hon'ble Supreme Court.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
There will be no order as to costs.
The copy of the judgment of Supreme Court
be kept on record.
 (K.J. Sengupta, J.)
 07.12.2012 JKJ
